#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Passive DNS Monitor
-------------------
Listens for DNS queries and responses on a given network interface and prints
a summary of which clients are looking up which domains. Useful for diagnosing
Wi-Fi slowness, identifying chatty/rogue devices, and spotting abnormal lookup
patterns.

Requirements:
    pip install scapy

Usage:
    sudo python3 dns_monitor.py -i wlan0
    sudo python3 dns_monitor.py -i eth0 --log dns.log
    sudo python3 dns_monitor.py -i wlan0 --top-interval 30

NOTE:
  * Must be run with privileges that allow raw packet capture (e.g. root, or
    with CAP_NET_RAW / CAP_NET_ADMIN).
  * Only deploy on networks you own or are explicitly authorized to monitor.
    Capturing traffic on networks without authorization may be illegal in your
    jurisdiction.
  * On a switched network you will only see DNS traffic to/from the host
    running this script unless you use a SPAN/mirror port. On Wi-Fi you may
    need monitor mode to see other clients' traffic; otherwise you'll see
    only what your AP forwards to this host.
"""
